meta.title: Selvedge Jeans from the Friday the 13th Movie! (Jason Voorhees/Japanese Denim)
meta.description:
*Flashing lights warning*

Ah yes, Fall, Halloween, Friday the 13th, Jason Voorhees, his mom. Me and being scared in the woods. It's just about as classic as Dunkin' or Starbucks pumpkin spice latte. Which actually I'm going to go buy after I write this here description.

Follow me like Jason's mom followed Annie. @8thWeekday 

Are we looking at the best mens denim jeans? Yes because...they are killer. Get it? Killer. Anyways today we are looking at some raw selvedge jeans by none other than Naked and Famous. This is their Friday the 13th Special featuring none other than the man himself, Jason. The perfect pair to wear for the Fall season and beyond! 

These jeans are made in Canada from Japanese denim and are woven with low tension. They are also redcast, which I talked about in my last Tanuki video! Again there are no scary stories in this video, so I bet it's fine but still...
